summary: Learn to assess campaign, CRM and pipeline data and create practical revenue decision briefs. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Data-driven sales and marketing decision making connects campaign activity with customer responses and sales outcomes. For sales, marketing, campaign and operations professionals, this course builds practical skills to frame revenue questions, check CRM and campaign data, and interpret funnel, cohort and CAC-to-CLV measures. Learners also practise assessing A/B test results and turning findings into concise budget and follow-up recommendations while accounting for data gaps and limits on causal claims.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who use campaign, customer or pipeline evidence to guide commercial decisions. It is designed for sales and marketing roles that need practical measurement and reporting skills, including those new to formal analytics.
prerequisites: No prior analytics training is required. Familiarity with basic sales, marketing or CRM terminology will help you connect the exercises to your work. Coding or programming is not required; analysis exercises use spreadsheet functions. Advanced attribution and experimentation topics receive foundation-level, conceptual coverage rather than technical implementation.
